ownership: Root proposed the paragraph/working-unit counter family and selected the population separately. bounded_idea_supply checked predecessor scopes and the algebra without native rows, count vectors, images or experiment results.
contract: Every complete source-marked paragraph in the prospectively fixed population is counted in the declared working-unit alphabet. All glyph units in that paragraph contribute; no awkward words or lines are omitted from an included paragraph.
Each working unit g has one globally fixed integer contribution w_g. Every complete included paragraph has the SAME total C, itself an unknown integer shared by that reader's population.
The nontrivial candidate requires at least one nonzero contribution on an actually observed working unit. Weights on absent units alone do not make a functioning observed counter.

This is a common endpoint requirement, not merely permission to erase/reset an arbitrary counter at the paragraph boundary. An unconditional reset after a paragraph would not imply a common accumulated total and is outside this tested claim.
The proposed paragraph interpretation and22-unit segmentation remain model assumptions. No source word, sound, semantic arity or independently established syntactic boundary is inferred.

algebra.matrix: Let m be the number of actually active working units and n_p in Z^m the count vector for included paragraph p. Form A with rows [n_p,-1]. The common-total equations are A*(w_1,...,w_m,C)^T=0.
algebra.full_rank: If rank over Q of A is m+1, its rational nullspace is zero. Every integer solution is rational, so all observed weights and C are zero. This excludes every nontrivial fixed integer counter in the declared class.
algebra.nonfull_rank: For a nonempty paragraph population, a nonzero rational null vector can be scaled by a common denominator to an integer vector. It cannot have all w_g=0 and C nonzero, since the last matrix column is constant -1. This supplies necessary additive capacity only; it supplies no useful parser or semantic assignment.
algebra.difference_equivalence: Choose one reference paragraph n_0. Subtract its augmented row from the others to obtain [n_p-n_0,0], while retaining [n_0,-1]. Therefore rank(A)=1+rank(D), where D consists of count differences. Full augmented rank is equivalent to full rational rank m of D.
algebra.fixed_constant_caveat: A surviving integer solution with some C does not guarantee a solution with a separately required C=0 or C=-1, or with weights constrained to -1/0/+1. Full rank excludes those subclasses too; nonfull rank does not confirm them.
algebra.certificate: A nonzero exact determinant of an (m+1)-row square augmented minor is a sufficient full-rank certificate, with its original paragraph row identifiers and exact count vectors. Numerical tolerance is not a rank certificate.
algebra.renaming: A single global bijection of working-unit labels only permutes the count columns and does not change rank.

counterexample_to_line_result_subsumptio.line_result: Requiring all four line sums to equal one common L gives w_a=2*w_b=2*w_a=w_b=L. Hence w_a=w_b=L=0. Indeed the line-count differences generate both singleton directions.
counterexample_to_line_result_subsumptio.paragraph_result: The paragraph count vectors are (1,2) and (2,1). They have equal nonzero total C=3 under w_a=w_b=1. Thus absence of a nonzero equal-line-sum counter does not imply absence of an equal-paragraph-sum counter.
counterexample_to_line_result_subsumptio.scope: A source-free synthetic example proving the logical distinction, not a manufactured source interpretation or manuscript observation.

This is a bounded distinction finding, not proof that every historic file was searched. The motivation is a simple common-completion counter at declared higher-level boundaries; it is not evidence that native paragraphs actually have that syntax.
outcomes_and_limits: Full active-column rank closes this precise fixed integer contribution/common paragraph-total class under the predeclared reader and paragraph scope. It does not reject general syntax, content-dependent counters, positional allographs, multiple scope types, errors or a different physical unit analysis.
Nonfull rank stops at necessary capacity. It does not license a bracket parser, context fit, expanded alphabet, alternate paragraph boundaries or semantic codebook.
Report only actually active units if fewer than22 are present. A zero column from an unseen working sign is not evidence of a useful surviving counter.

ZL and IT paragraph annotations must remain separate populations. RF lacks the required own paragraph metadata under the stated prior scope; projection from another reader would be a changed input assumption.
Whole-paragraph exclusion for a drawing gap, unsupported unit or incomplete source-row span preserves the intended total; dropping only the inconvenient part would not.

A within-page complete-marked-paragraph population is a conditional sampled representation. Full rank is an exact algebraic contradiction on those included observations, not independent historical confirmation of their atoms or boundaries.
